description: Neural network, second stage (docs/54): SST indices and rainfall regions (with a regions-only control), the DRN refitted on the same folds, a neural correction of EMOS and a forecast-only ablation, September-initialized ONDJ.
external_note: The DRN is refitted here (same folds, years and seeds as the first stage, so the same networks), so that every comparison uses the same scoring rule (scoring version 2: CRPS split at the observation, closed form for the censored shifted gamma); drn_sst against drn_regions isolates the SST indices. Quantile regression is refitted too (diagnostic): the method selection decided between it and the DRN for JJAS September amounts on a margin smaller than the scoring error of the earlier rule.
